title: Team Talk: Handling Requests at Work
instructions: 这是为成人英语学习者设计的模拟听力与语法练习（非官方雅思测试）。请先听/读对话，注意团队如何比较处理请求的不同方式，以及 have to / must / can 的用法。然后完成8道听力题和8道语法题。所有题目和选项均为英文；解释为中文。答案必须来自原文。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. Do you have a minute? I have a problem with the new requests.
Ben: Sure, Mia. What's up?
Mia: Three customers asked for changes today. I have to finish the report by five. I can't do everything.
Ben: I see. Last week, we had the same problem. We must decide who answers first.
Mia: Right. So, what do we have to do first?
Ben: We have to check the request time. Old requests come first.
Mia: OK. And who can call the customers?
Ben: You can call them. I can write the emails. But we must not forget the team meeting at four.
Mia: Good point. Yesterday, I forgot the meeting. I'm sorry.
Ben: No problem. Today, we can put a note on the computer.
Mia: Great. So, I have to call Mr. Lee first. He waited two days.
Ben: Yes. And I must send the report to Anna by three.
Mia: Can I help with the report?
Ben: Thanks, but you don't have to. I can finish it.
Mia: OK. Let's meet at three thirty to check.
Ben: Perfect. See you then.

Mia 说 “Yesterday, I forgot the meeting.”，所以是会议。

grammar.title: have to / must / can 与一般现在时和过去时对比
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，have to 表示“不得不”，强调客观需要；must 表示“必须”，强调说话人认为很重要；can 表示“可以/能够”，表示能力或许可。一般现在时表示经常或现在的情况，一般过去时表示过去发生的事。例如：I have to finish the report.（现在必须）I forgot the meeting yesterday.（过去忘记）。注意：have to 的否定是 don't have to（不必），must 的否定是 must not（禁止）。
grammar.example: I have to finish the report by five.

options: She have to call the customer.
She has to call the customer.
She must to call the customer.
answers: She has to call the customer.
questions.explanation: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，have to 变为 has to。must 后不加 to，can 后动词用原形。
questions.evidence: She has to call the customer.

options: We must not forget the meeting.
We don't must forget the meeting.
We not must forget the meeting.
We must not to forget the meeting.
answers: We must not forget the meeting.
questions.explanation: must 的否定是 must not，后接动词原形，不加 to。
questions.evidence: We must not forget the meeting.

options: You don't have to call him.
You not have to call him.
You don't has to call him.
answers: You don't have to call him.
questions.explanation: have to 的否定用 don't/doesn't have to，主语 you 用 don't。
questions.evidence: You don't have to call him.

options: I can to write the email.
questions.explanation: can 后接动词原形，不加 to，也不加 -s 或 -ing。
yesterday 表示过去，动词用过去式 forgot。
句子描述过去发生的事，用过去式 waited。

options: We have to check the time now.
We has to check the time now.
We have to checking the time now.
We have to checked the time now.
answers: We have to check the time now.
questions.explanation: 主语 We 用 have to，后接动词原形 check。
questions.evidence: We have to check the time now.

options: She can to call the customer.
questions.explanation: can 后接动词原形 call，不加 -s 或 to。

part1: What do you have to do at work or school?
What must you not forget today?
Can you finish your work by five?
speaking.part2: Describe a time you had to handle many requests. You should say: what the requests were; who asked you; what you had to do first; and how you felt.
part3: How do teams decide who does what?
What can people do to remember meetings?
Is it better to finish one big task or many small tasks? Why?

transfer.writing: Write 5–8 simple sentences about a busy day at work or school. Use have to, must, can, and the past tense. Say what you had to do, what you must not forget, and what you can do.
